basic_info.description: A no brainer investment opportunity on the Moss St artistic corridor.    4 1-bed units, two ready for new tenants.  Apartments are approximately a generous 725 sq ft and have original details.  This thoughtfully maintained building offers the perfect blend of historic charm and modern investment potential.   Spacious ground-floor storage area, complete with private yard access, presents exciting possibilities. Step outside to experience the city's stunning transformation of Moss Street into a curated artistic corridor, featuring bespoke sculptural lighting installations, vibrant murals, and thoughtfully designed planters that create an inspiring streetscape. An Edwardian building with flair, 19 Moss will pencil out for any investor in town! Centrally located, new roof, new paint, vacant units, what more could anyone ask for?  Contact Steve Caravelli at 415-706-0008 for showings.
